summary: Master organisational design and operating models. Learn to build Target Operating Models (TOM) using Galbraith’s Star Model. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Organisational design training helps transformation, strategy and HR professionals align structures, capabilities and ways of working with organisational goals. It covers diagnosing structures, mapping capabilities and value streams, and designing governance, decision rights and service delivery models. Participants also practice integrating automation into workflows, aligning performance measures and planning the transition to a target operating model.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for shaping the structural and operational future of their organizations.
modules: Capability Mapping and Value Stream Design
Governance, Decision Rights and RACI Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in management, human resources, strategy, or operational leadership. A basic understanding of business strategy and organizational charts is required. No prior experience with specific design software is necessary, though familiarity with Microsoft Visio or Lucidchart is beneficial.
